Name: (DGA) and (CP) Barfyscorpion Home Decor
Author: ennoevlys
Description:
This mod either replaces some furniture items in the game (Content Patcher version) or adds new furniture items to the game (Custom Furniture version). Please download your files accordingly!

[size=5]Install (Content Patcher)[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher.[/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*](optional) Open the ﻿[code]content.json[/code] file and choose which furniture items you want to appear by replacing [code]true[/code] with [code]false[/code] on whatever you don't want added.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use (Content Patcher)[/size]
Once you've downloaded the content pack and dropped it into your Mods folder, feel free to open the content.json and choose to enable or disable each specific piece of furniture. By default, all are enabled (set to "true") but if you'd like to turn one off, just change the "true" to "false". Each item has a name so you don't need to hunt through the spritesheet to figure out what's what. :D

[size=5]Install (Dynamic Game Assets)[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install the latest version of Content Patcher.[/url]﻿﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Install the latest version of SpaceCore.[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Install the latest version of DGA.[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use (Dynamic Game Assets)[/size]
Once you've downloaded the content pack and placed it in your Mods folder, the furniture will be available through the Furniture Catalogue. The Furniture Catalogue item is purchasable through Robin's Carpenter's Store for 200,000g after upgrading your farmhouse once (this is vanilla game behavior). Items are also available for purchase directly from Robin. (Probably. I think. I haven't used DGA yet myself.)


[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6+ on Linux/Mac/Windows.
[*]Works in single player. 
[*]Works in multiplayer with no issues as the Content Patcher version (if you want your friends to see it, they should also download the mod though). 
[*]If you wish to download the DGA version so that the vanilla furniture/already-replaced-vanilla-furniture isn't overwritten, the other players will have to install the other prerequisites in addition to this mod. Not having all players install these will cause the game to crash (most likely for the person without the files installed), as the game will attempt to load image files that aren't there.
[/list]

[size=5]Up Next![/size]
[*][s]I'm hoping to convert the matching walls and floors to both CP and CWF in the near future. Those will probably be uploaded as a separate mod, but I'll be sure to have this one link to it once it's released.[/s] 3/23/23: It's been such a long time that PyTK is being discontinued so this probably isn't happening.
[*]I can also convert the buildings found in the original thread if anyone wants them, but as I'm not using them myself, I won't without a request.
